purpose: Measure JEV entry and exit judgments at the exact completed-bar snapshot price while reducing repeated input tokens.

window.note: 2022 minute history is used for warm-up; 2023 is a previously inspected development year, not a blind test.

model.input_note: Send current completed five-minute OHLC, relative volume, derived intraday/daily features, limit room, account state, and data caveats. Omit repeated 24-bar history and 65 prior daily close array.

execution.fill_price: exact close of the completed five-minute bar shown in the same JEV snapshot
execution.purpose_note: Idealized decision-attribution diagnostic; not executable return evidence.

spend_guard.required_baseline: Refresh the TypeSafe Usage page before every live run and pass its displayed spend plus timestamp.
spend_guard.local_guard: Before each uncached call, add a conservative token-cost reserve and all local JevQuant spend logged after the supplied baseline timestamp. Stop before the projected total exceeds the account limit.
spend_guard.caveat: Usage dashboard says statistics may be delayed; avoid concurrent callers on the same account during a guarded run.

known_data_limitations: Five-minute labels are assumed to mark interval ends; provider semantics are unverified.
Availability is assumed at interval end; actual historical publication delay is unknown.
Security status is retrospective, not point-in-time proven.
Cash dividend event coverage in the current table is scoped to 2023-2024.
The 2023-01-01 through 2023-04-09 trading-rule interval remains uncovered by the current effective-date registry.
